name: Town & Country Village
summary: Upscale mall with chains & specialty stores, services & eateries amid pedestrian walkways & gardens.
demographics: Town & Country Village primarily serves affluent West Houston families and professionals in the Memorial area, one of Houston's most desirable neighborhoods known for high household incomes and educated residents. The trade area attracts upper-middle-class shoppers aged 30-65 with significant disposable income who value convenience, quality retailers, and comprehensive service offerings. Visitors typically seek upscale shopping experiences combined with lifestyle amenities, preferring the center's open-air format and one-stop convenience for both daily errands and leisure activities.
description: Town & Country Village is Houston's premier west side shopping destination, located at the northeast quadrant of Memorial Drive and Beltway 8 (Sam Houston Tollway). This open-air lifestyle center features more than 90 retailers spanning mainstream brands, stylish boutiques, fine dining restaurants, casual eateries, and comprehensive service providers. The center distinguishes itself with lush garden-scaped patios, fountains, and the Grand Plaza Park where visitors can dine al fresco and enjoy the outdoor ambiance. Beyond shopping and dining, Town & Country Village serves as a true one-stop destination offering grocery shopping at Randalls Flagship, banking services with major financial institutions, healthcare and dental services, beauty and spa amenities including Beautique Day Spa and Oasis Nails Lounge, fitness studios, Barnes & Noble, and Walgreens pharmacy. With convenient storefront parking and its strategic location in West Houston's Memorial area, the center has established itself as the go-to spot for quality fashion apparel, accessories, jewelry, furniture, home goods, and essential services for families throughout the community.
